verdict.rationale: Choosing official OS variants is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence mentions editions such as Windows 11 Pro, LTSC and Server 2019, but nothing shows these variants ship different desktop environments or default app sets. StartAllBack is a third-party workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can choose among official variants of the OS with different desktop environments and default apps
